snapshot.title: Daemon discovery and auto-start
snapshot.description:
Every CLI command finds this repo's daemon and starts it if needed.

- Find the repo root (`daemon.FindRepoRoot`), read `.kiln/run/daemon.json` and health-check the address.
- If no daemon answers, start `kiln serve` detached (own process group, output to a log under `.kiln/run/`), then wait until it's ready, with a timeout and a clear error.
- Handle a stale `daemon.json` (process gone) and a held lock (`ErrAlreadyRunning`) without starting a second daemon.
- Give commands a shared Connect client (`kilnv1connect.NewKilnServiceClient`).

Tests: auto-start from a cold repo, reuse of a running daemon, stale `daemon.json`.
